copy.tagline: 评估SaaS业务的单位经济性和资本效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断SaaS业务能否高效规模化或需要调整方向
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate SaaS unit economics and capital efficiency for your business
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether your SaaS business can scale efficiently or needs correction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你计算 SaaS 单位经济效益和资本效率指标，如 CAC、LTV、回本周期、烧钱率等，并判断业务是否可规模化扩张。
howto.when: 当你询问 SaaS 业务能否规模化、需要评估单位经济效益或准备董事会效率分析时触发。

say.text: 评估我们的 SaaS 单位经济效益，CAC 是 5000 美元。
分析我们的烧钱率和跑道，月收入 40 万，月支出 80 万。
say.note: Claude 会计算净烧钱率和剩余跑道月数。

say.text: 检查我们的 Rule of 40，增长率 60%，利润率 -20%。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you calculate SaaS unit economics and capital efficiency metrics such as CAC, LTV, payback period, burn rate, etc., and assess whether the business can scale efficiently.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask whether a SaaS business can scale, need to evaluate unit economics, or prepare efficiency analysis for a board review.

say_en.text: Evaluate our SaaS unit economics, CAC is $5,000.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate LTV, LTV:CAC ratio, and provide interpretation.

say_en.text: Analyze our burn rate and runway, monthly revenue $400K, monthly spend $800K.
say_en.note: Claude will compute net burn rate and remaining runway in months.

say_en.text: Check our Rule of 40, growth rate 60%, profit margin -20%.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate the Rule of 40 score and assess health.
